desc: Independent learning in a performative Markov potential game. The control
for PACT_THEORY Theorem B2 (performative stability of the estimator).
Source: Sahitaj, Sasnauskas, Yalin, Mandal & Radanovic, arXiv:2504.20593.
arm = inpg  independent NATURAL policy gradient, which the paper proves
converges to a performatively stable equilibrium in the LAST iterate.
'ipga' is their plain policy gradient ascent; 'cont' keeps INPG but
drops the deployment schedule, isolating it.
deploy_window = 64   days per deployment before a retrain. Chosen as one
full host batch per agent: URB gives one sample per agent per day and
ippo/config1.json sets batch_size = 64, so a window shorter than this
could not retrain at all. Not tuned on returns.
retrain_epochs = 20   passes over the window per deployment. Repeated
RISK MINIMISATION means retraining to convergence on the deployment's
own data, not taking a few steps on it.
eta = 0.5   the natural-gradient step in logit space. For a softmax
policy the NPG step is exactly a shift of the logits by
